description_en: If you need to update SMS qualification information, you can submit a modification request through this API. After submission, it will re-enter the review process
description_zh: 如果您需要更新短信资质信息，可通过本接口提交修改请求，提交后将重新进入审核流程
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi update-sms-qualification --qualification-group-id 100000000 --order-id 200100000 --business-license-pics Type=businessLicense LicensePic=123456/111.png --company-name '阿里云云通信有限公司' --bussiness-license-exp-date '2023-01-01~2033-01-01' --legal-person-id-card-front-side 123456/111.png --legal-person-id-card-back-side 123456/111.png --legal-person-name '李华' --legal-person-id-card-no 511391000000005123 --legal-person-id-card-eff-time '2023-01-01~2033-01-01' --legal-person-id-card-type identityCard --admin-id-card-pic 123456/111.png --admin-id-card-front-face 123456/111.png --admin-name '李华' --admin-id-card-no 511391000000005123 --admin-id-card-exp-date '2023-01-01~2033-01-01' --admin-phone-no 13700000000 --certify-code 1234 --admin-id-card-type identityCard --other-files LicensePic=123456/111.png --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSmsQualification

parameters.help_en: The qualification ID, that is, the ID returned when you [apply for SMS qualification](~~SubmitSmsQualification~~). You can obtain the qualification IDs under the current account by calling [Query Qualification List](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)
parameters.help_zh: 资质ID，即您[申请短信资质](~~SubmitSmsQualification~~)返回的ID。您可以通过[查询资质列表](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)获取当前账号下的资质ID
parameters.name: qualification_group_id

parameters.help_en: The review order ID. You can obtain the qualifications and their corresponding review order IDs under the current account by calling [Query Qualification List](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)
parameters.help_zh: 审核工单ID。您可以通过[查询资质列表](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)获取当前账号下的资质及其对应审核工单ID
parameters.name: order_id

element_fields.help_en:
Business license type. Valid values:

- socialCreditLicense: Social credit code certificate.
- businessLicense: Enterprise business license.
- signLegalLicense: Public institution legal person certificate.
- otherLicense: Other.

Choose one to upload. The certificate must contain: enterprise name, unified social credit code, and certificate validity period
element_fields.help_zh:
营业证件类型。取值：

- socialCreditLicense：社会信用代码证书。
- businessLicense：企业营业执照。
- signLegalLicense：事业单位法人证书。
- otherLicense：其他。

选择一种上传即可，证件上需含有：企业名称、统一社会信用代码、证件有效期
element_fields.name: type

element_fields.help_en:
Business license image. Only jpg, png, gif, and jpeg image formats are supported, and the image must not exceed 5 MB. Please provide the path of the file uploaded to OSS. The file name to be uploaded must not contain Chinese characters or special characters. For upload operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html.

><notice>
No stamp is required for color originals of the certificate. If you upload a photocopy or black-and-white photo, you must affix the enterprise red seal to the photocopy and take a photo to upload.
></notice>
element_fields.help_zh:
营业证件图片，仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。请填写上传到OSS的文件路径参数，待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符，上传操作请参见通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html。

><notice>
证件的彩色原件无需盖章，若上传复印件/黑白照片，需要在复印件上加盖企业红章并拍照上传。
></notice>
element_fields.name: license_pic

parameters.help_en: Enterprise business license information. This parameter is required when the purpose of the qualification to be modified is for use by others
parameters.help_zh: 企业营业证件信息。待修改的资质用途为他用时，此参数必填
parameters.name: business_license_pics

parameters.example: 阿里云云通信有限公司
parameters.help_en: Enterprise name. Supported symbols are only the middle dot `·`, the Chinese symbols `【】（）`, the English symbols `()`, and the `space`. Other symbols or pure numbers are not allowed. The length must not exceed 150 characters
parameters.help_zh: 企业名称。符号仅支持中点`·`、中文`【】（）`、英文`()`及`空格`，不可含其他符号或纯数字，长度不超过150字符
parameters.name: company_name

parameters.help_en:
Validity period of the business license. Format: YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD.
> When the certificate validity period is long-term, the end date can be set to 2099-12-31
parameters.help_zh:
营业证件有效期。有效期格式：YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD。
> 证照有效期为长期时，截止日期可填：2099-12-31
parameters.name: bussiness_license_exp_date

parameters.help_en:
Photo of the front of the legal representative's ID card (national emblem side). Only jpg, png, gif, and jpeg image formats are supported, and the image must not exceed 5 MB. Please provide the path of the file uploaded to OSS. The file name to be uploaded must not contain Chinese characters or special characters. For upload operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html.
> The system will use the legal person name and ID number you provide for verification. If the verification fails, you need to upload a photo of the legal representative's ID card
parameters.help_zh:
法定代表人证件正面照片（身份证国徽面），仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。请填写上传到OSS的文件路径参数，待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符，上传操作请参见通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html。
> 系统会使用您填写的法人姓名、证件号码进行校验；若校验不通过，则需要上传法定代表人身份证件照片
parameters.name: legal_person_id_card_front_side

parameters.help_en:
Photo of the back of the legal representative's ID card (portrait side). Only jpg, png, gif, and jpeg image formats are supported, and the image must not exceed 5 MB. Please provide the path of the file uploaded to OSS. The file name to be uploaded must not contain Chinese characters or special characters. For upload operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html.
> The system will use the legal person name and ID number you provide for verification. If the verification fails, you need to upload a photo of the legal representative's ID card
parameters.help_zh:
法定代表人证件反面照片（身份证人像面），仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。请填写上传到OSS的文件路径参数，待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符，上传操作请参见通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html。
> 系统会使用您填写的法人姓名、证件号码进行校验；若校验不通过，则需要上传法定代表人身份证件照片
parameters.name: legal_person_id_card_back_side

parameters.help_en:
Name of the legal representative.

> - If there is no legal representative information on the organization's certificate, but there is information about a person in charge / chief representative or similar, please prepare the ID card photo of the corresponding person in charge or chief representative listed on the certificate.
> - If there is no legal representative information on the organization's certificate, and there is no information about any person in charge, please prepare the name and ID card photo of the main business contact person
parameters.help_zh:
法定代表人姓名。

> - 若组织证件中无法定代表人信息，但存在负责人/首席代表等相关信息，请准备证件中对应负责人或首席代表的身份证件照片。
> - 若组织证件中无法定代表人信息，且无任何负责人信息，请准备业务主要负责人的姓名、身份证件照片
parameters.name: legal_person_name

parameters.help_en: Legal person's ID number
parameters.help_zh: 法人证件号码

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_en:
Administrator name.

> The administrator (also known as the operator) refers to the person who logs in to the Alibaba Cloud account and manages the SMS service. Generally, this is the operations personnel who manages qualifications, signatures, and templates and sends SMS messages under this Alibaba Cloud account, and whose phone number can receive verification codes. The administrator is not necessarily the administrator of this Alibaba Cloud account. The administrator can be the same person as the enterprise's legal representative
parameters.help_zh:
管理员姓名。

> 管理员（又称经办人）指登录阿里云账号并管理短信业务的人员，一般是贵方管理此阿里云账号下资质、签名和模板，并进行短信发送的相关运营人员，且此人手机号可接收验证码。管理员不一定是此阿里云账号的管理员，管理员可以与企业法人为同一人
parameters.name: admin_name

parameters.help_zh: 管理员证件号码
parameters.name: admin_id_card_no

Validity period of the administrator ID card. Format: YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD.
> When the certificate validity period is long-term, the end date can be set to 2099-12-31
parameters.help_zh:

> 证件有效期为长期时，截止日期可填：2099-12-31
parameters.name: admin_id_card_exp_date

parameters.help_en: Administrator's mobile phone number. Format: +/+86/0086/86 prefix or a phone number without any prefix, for example, 1390000****
parameters.help_zh: 管理员手机号码，格式：+/+86/0086/86 或无任何前缀的手机号码，例如1390000****
parameters.name: admin_phone_no

parameters.help_en:
Phone verification code. Please call the [RequiredPhoneCode](~~RequiredPhoneCode~~) API and pass in the **administrator's phone number**, then enter the SMS verification code you receive here.

> You can use [ValidPhoneCode](~~ValidPhoneCode~~) to verify whether the SMS verification code is correct before passing it in
parameters.help_zh:
手机号验证码。请调用[RequiredPhoneCode](~~RequiredPhoneCode~~)接口并传入**管理员手机号码**后，在此填入接收到的短信验证码。

> 您可以使用[ValidPhoneCode](~~ValidPhoneCode~~)自行校验短信验证码是否准确后再传入
parameters.name: certify_code
